165
Development of logistic parks
*521. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Railways plan to develop
logistic parks to serve as 'one-stop shop' at
various places alongside the route of the
proposed dedicated freight corridor;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what are the details of plots that are
proposed to be developed on the ECoR
system?
Laying of water pipelines crossing the
railway track
*522. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI  SURENDRA MOTILAL
PATEL:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is necessary for the States
to get permission from the railway
authorities for laying water pipelines where
these have to cross the railway track;
(b) if so, whether the delay in permission
caused the delay in implementation of the
projects;
(c) the number of such proposals
received from the various States which are
pending with the Railways for the last three
years, particularly for the State of Gujarat;
and
(d) by when these proposals would be
cleared?
Reduction of maternal deaths
*523. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of one
lakh deliveries, 300 pregnant women die
every year and with only an average of 16
point reduction in figure, India cannot reach
its Millennium Development Goals of
lowering the maternal deaths to 200 by
2007 and 109 by 2015;
(b) whether this conclusion is based on
the study report released by Government
in October, 2006;

166
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether after receiving the report,
strong Government policies would be
required to meet the target; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to achieve the target set up by 2015?
Dependence on edible oil import
†*524. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the attention of
Government has been drawn towards the
White Paper related to oilseed sector
released by the Solvent Extract on
Association of India;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
increasing dependence of the country on
import for supply of edible oils can cause
further crisis; and
(c) if so, the reaction of Government
thereon?
Telephone booths on stations
*525. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
SHRI K.E. ISMAIL:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that telephone
booths were allotted to handicapped
persons in Railway Stations across the
country under a Central Government
Scheme to rehabilitate the disabled in 1981,
the International Year of Disabled;
(b) if so, how many such booths were
allotted all over the country, Railway Zone-
wise and what are the terms and conditions
of such allotment;
(c) whether it is also a fact that their
agreement has expired on April 27, this year;
(d) if so, whether Government have a
proposal to further extension of the
agreement to the existing booth owners;
and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Modernisation of ECoR
*526. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to spend
around Rs. 3 lakh crore for modernisation
of Railways;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of modernisation projects
that would be undertaken on the ECoR
under this plan head ?
SGC offices
*527. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Save Grain
Campaign (SGC) offices in the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that there is no
SGC office in Andhra Pradesh;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) the details of technologies and
technical know-how developed by the
Indian Grain Storage Management and
Research Institute for benefitting farmers
in minimizing post-harvesting losses in
foodgrains; and
(e) the number of farmers trained under
the SGC in Andhra Pradesh during the last
three years year-wise?

167
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Study on impact of global warming

Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:

towns and cities along India’s eastern coast
would be devastated with global warming
intensifying cyclones and rising sea levels
eroding vast stretches of the shoreline;
(b) if so, whether Government have done
any comprehensive study on the impact of
global warming in the coastal areas;

Exploitation of Indian Ocean and EEZ
for tuna fishing
3967. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
help entrepreneurs exploit the Indian Ocean
and our EEZ for tuna fishing;
(b) whether Government propose to
extend financial subsidies to develop the
new tuna sector;
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(d) whether it is a fact that hundreds of
foreign trawlers fish in the Indian Ocean
for valuable tuna fishes;
(e) if so, whether Government have been
slow to help entrepreneurs develop the art
and technique of tuna fishing;
(f) the obstacles being faced by
entrepreneurs in sustaining tuna fishing; and
(g) the steps proposed to be taken by
Government to solve their problems?
Seeds developed by Rajendra
Agriculture University, Pusa
†3968. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the advanced variety of seeds and
their types developed, so far, through
research carried out by the Rajendra
Agriculture University, Pusa, Samastipur
in Bihar for the prosperity and progress of
agriculture and related sector;
(b) the results achieved, so far, in the
development of agriculture and its related
areas after the development of such seeds
and their types; and
(c) the maximum potential of
agricultural production including foodgrain
production in Bihar?
Procurement of mustard seeds at MSP
3969. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
have made any arrangement for
procurement of mustard seeds at support

922
price through NAFED, as about more than
25 lakh tonnes of mustard seed produce
are expected this year;
(b) if so, the criteria fixed by the Central
Government, so far, for the procurement
of mustard seeds by cooperating the
farmers in distress; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Decline in public investment
3970. SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is
decline in public investment in agriculture;
and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Legislation for checking forcible
acquisition of land
†3971. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
introduce a bill to check the forcible
acquisition of land of farmers for different
reasons by the State Governments; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Benefits to women farmers under
NAIS
3972. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) how many women farmers have
availed the benefit of National Agricultural
Insurance Scheme (NAIS);
(b) whether there is any other insurance
scheme to help specifically female headed
farmer households; and
(c) if not, given the increasing number
of female headed households, whether
Government would consider framing such
a policy?
Laying of report of Dr. M.S.
Swaminathan on agriculture
3973. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government would lay on
the Table of the House the report of
Dr. M.S. Swaminathan on agriculture which
had been recently submitted to
Government;
(b if so, by when; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Innovation schemes for farming in
Maharashtra
3974. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
through innovation schemes the prospects
for productivity growth have improved by
promoting a farming system approach
rather than a commodity specific approach;
(b) if so, whether any such scheme/
schemes are intended to be adopted in tribal
and backward districts of Vidarbha
like Yavatmal, Amravati, etc. so that the
farmers get remunerative price for their
crops; and
(c) whether the Indian Council of

special team to Maharashtra for
dissemination of the technology and
methods?
Foodgrains requirement
3975. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total quantum of food production
in the country during the last five years,
year-wise, State-wise and produce-wise;
(b) the total quantum of food procured
and procurement price paid to farmers
during that period, year-wise, State-wise
and produce-wise;
(c) whether foodgrains are being
imported to meet the domestic demand
